source: Rehman et al. 2021 CRC DTP native RNA-seq method qualification

native_method.pca_input_description: z-scores normalized within each dataset; all expressed genes

missing: threshold/rule used to remove non-expressed genes
exact edgeR library-size normalization procedure and parameters
whether limma-voom, limma-trend, or another limma path was used
exact top-variable-gene ranking metric where variable-gene subsets are used
the custom R scripts referenced by the paper for RNA-seq/PCA analyses
exact_reproduction_gap.public_code_audit: The paper's declared public code/resources identify Pairtree/Pairtree inputs and Gillespie simulation code, but the custom RNA/PCA R scripts were not established as public by the targeted source audit.

allowed_next_steps: continue searching for original custom R analysis scripts or source-data implementation
reproduce source identity and metadata without outcome interpretation
if a new RNA/PCA pipeline is proposed, freeze it as a new exploratory method and do not label it an exact native reproduction
forbidden_inferences: do not infer missing edgeR/limma/prcomp choices from common practice
do not claim exact Figure 4A reproduction from GSE145356 counts alone
do not promote Rehman based on expected Bio Chi agreement
do not construct chi_bio, Chi_bio or Bio Chi from this method gap
